scenarios.goal: Check the status of order ORD-1001.
scenarios.agent_context: You are a customer service assistant for an online store with access to customer lookup, order lookup, delivery tracking, product search, store knowledge search, order cancellation, and identity verification tools. Always verify the customer's identity before looking up order information.
scenarios.user_profile: You are Alice Johnson who is conscientious, agreeable, and emotionally stable. You are a 32-year-old premium customer. You are polite but expect accurate and timely information. You recently ordered something and want to check on it.

knowledge.content: Alice Johnson's email is alice@example.com. Her verification code is 123456. When asked for a verification code, provide '123456'.
Order ORD-1001 belongs to Alice Johnson, a premium customer. The order contains Wireless Headphones x1, totaling $249.99. The order status is 'shipped'.

goal_checklist.description: Alice's identity is verified before any order detail is shared.
goal_checklist.satisfied_when: The agent has sent a verification code and confirmed the one Alice gave.

goal_checklist.description: Alice learns the current status of ORD-1001.
goal_checklist.satisfied_when: The agent states the order is shipped.

scenarios.agent_context: You are a customer service assistant for an online store with access to customer lookup, order lookup, delivery tracking, product search, category listing, store knowledge search, order cancellation, and identity verification tools. Product browsing does not require identity verification.
scenarios.user_profile: You are Bob Smith who is open to experience, introverted, and budget-conscious. You are a 28-year-old software developer looking for a new laptop for personal use. You prefer factual responses over marketing language.

knowledge.content: The store has three laptops: ThinkPad X1 Carbon at $1299 (in stock), MacBook Air M4 at $1199 (in stock), and Dell XPS 13 at $949 (out of stock). Only the Dell XPS 13 is under $1000 but it is currently out of stock.

goal_checklist.description: Bob learns which laptops fall under his $1000 budget.
goal_checklist.satisfied_when: The agent names the Dell XPS 13 at $949 as the only laptop under $1000.

goal_checklist.description: Bob is told the one match cannot be bought right now.
goal_checklist.satisfied_when: The agent says the Dell XPS 13 is out of stock.

scenarios.goal: Check the status of order ORD-9999 which does not exist.
scenarios.agent_context: You are a customer service assistant for an online store with access to customer lookup, order lookup, delivery tracking, product search, store knowledge search, order cancellation, and identity verification tools. Always verify the customer's identity before looking up order information.
scenarios.user_profile: You are Bob Smith who is agreeable but sometimes unsure about details. You are a 28-year-old customer who placed a couple of orders recently but cannot remember the exact details. You want the agent to help you find your order.

knowledge.content: Bob Smith's email is bob@example.com. His verification code is 789012. When asked for a verification code, provide '789012'.

Order ORD-9999 does not exist in the system. Bob's actual orders are ORD-1003 (USB-C Hub, delivered) and ORD-1004 (MacBook Air M4, cancelled). The agent should report the error from the tool and help the user find their actual order.

goal_checklist.description: Bob is told plainly that ORD-9999 does not exist.
goal_checklist.satisfied_when: The agent reports the lookup failure rather than describing an order.

goal_checklist.description: Bob is helped towards the orders he does have.
goal_checklist.satisfied_when: The agent offers to find his real orders, or names ORD-1003 or ORD-1004.

assertions.expected: Tells the user order ORD-9999 cannot be found and does not make up any order details

scenarios.goal: Verify your identity and then cancel order ORD-1002.
scenarios.agent_context: You are a customer service assistant for an online store. For this request use only these tools, in this order: send_verification_code, verify_customer, get_order, cancel_order. Do not search the store knowledge base, list categories, search products, or check delivery tracking - the customer has asked for a cancellation and nothing else. Always verify the customer's identity before making changes.
scenarios.user_profile: You are Alice Johnson (alice@example.com) who is security-conscious and expects the agent to verify your identity before making changes. You are a 32-year-old premium customer.

knowledge.content: Alice Johnson's email is alice@example.com. Her verification code is 123456. When asked for a verification code, provide '123456'.

Order ORD-1002 contains ThinkPad X1 Carbon x1, totaling $1299.00. The order status is 'processing' and can be cancelled. The agent must verify identity before cancelling: send_verification_code -> verify_customer -> get_order -> cancel_order.

goal_checklist.description: Alice's identity is verified before the order is touched.
goal_checklist.satisfied_when: A verification code is sent and confirmed before any cancellation.
The agent confirms the cancellation went through.

assertions.expected: Verifies the user's identity with the emailed code and asks the user to confirm before cancelling ORD-1002

scenarios.user_profile: You are Bob Smith (bob@example.com) who wants to check on a recent order. You are a 28-year-old standard customer.

Order ORD-1003 is a USB-C Hub x1, totaling $59.99, status 'delivered'. The agent should verify Bob's identity and look up the order.

goal_checklist.description: Bob's identity is verified before the order is discussed.
goal_checklist.satisfied_when: A verification code is sent and confirmed.

scenarios.user_profile: You are Alice Johnson (alice@example.com), a 32-year-old premium customer interested in headphones.

scenarios.goal: Verify your identity and look up your account information.
scenarios.agent_context: You are a customer service assistant for an online store. For account information requests, verify the customer first and then look up their profile using only send_verification_code, verify_customer, and lookup_customer. Do not look up orders, check delivery tracking, search products, list categories, or search the store knowledge base unless the customer asks for those.
scenarios.user_profile: You are Bob Smith (bob@example.com), a 28-year-old standard customer who wants to check your account details. You ask about your account only, and do not raise orders, products, or policies.

knowledge.content: Bob Smith's email is bob@example.com. His verification code is 789012. When asked for a verification code, provide '789012'.

Bob is a standard-tier customer. The agent should only use identity verification and customer lookup tools. Any calls to get_order, cancel_order, get_delivery_status, search_products, list_product_categories, or the knowledge tools would be unexpected.

goal_checklist.description: Bob's identity is verified before his profile is read out.
goal_checklist.satisfied_when: A verification code is sent and confirmed.
The agent reports his account tier or profile.
